usedFor: innoChat runs chatbots, where “Send Message” gets a bot reply and “New Message In Session” notices new messages.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message In Session” in innoChat, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A message in a chat session can produce a scheduling link for follow-up.

watchOut: “New Message In Session” is polling, so new messages are noticed on a schedule, not instantly.
